description: Source code for a NativeOllamaHandler class that manages interactions with the Ollama API, including message creation, model fetching, and error handling. Contains functions for converting messages and estimating token counts.

classes.name: NativeOllamaHandler
classes.description: A class that handles communication with the Ollama API, including message streaming, model management, and error handling.

methods.name: convertToolsToOllama
methods.description: Converts OpenAI format tools to Ollama's native tool format.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a message stream with the Ollama API, handling token estimation, tool calls, and streaming response.

methods.name: fetchModel
methods.description: Fetches available models from Ollama and updates internal state.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Returns the current model ID and info, with fallback to default info if not initialized.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt synchronously using the Ollama API.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the handler by fetching models, ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Ensures the handler is initialized before proceeding.

methods.name: ensureClient
methods.description: Creates and returns the Ollama client instance.
